label: Which nets moved
subgoals: Extract before and after with identical settings
Compute each net's change in parasitics
Count nets whose change exceeds the tolerance

label: Unexpected movers
subgoals: Form the expected set from the claimed nets and their neighbours
Find moved nets outside that set
Report each unexpected mover with its change

label: The pass rule
subgoals: Count the claimed nets that did not move
Accept the ECO only when the total is zero
